scripts.test: npm run check:typescript && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: NUXT_APP_BASE_URL=/ BUILD_OUTPUT= npm run generate && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:docker: NUXT_APP_BASE_URL=/ BUILD_OUTPUT= npm run generate && docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -v "$PWD:$PWD" -w "$PWD" mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble npx playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: NUXT_APP_BASE_URL=/ BUILD_OUTPUT= npm run generate && playwright test --ui
scripts.screenshots: NUXT_APP_BASE_URL=/ BUILD_OUTPUT= npm run generate && UPDATE_REPO_SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/responsive.spec.ts
scripts.screenshots:docker: NUXT_APP_BASE_URL=/ BUILD_OUTPUT= npm run generate && docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -e UPDATE_REPO_SCREENSHOTS=1 -v "$PWD:$PWD" -w "$PWD" mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble npx playwright test tests/e2e/responsive.spec.ts
